Name: EQUIP_PARAM_CUSTOM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Preset weapon rolls: a base weapon and upgrade level, a skill from a skill table (the skill can change the weapon's affinity), three effects from effect tables, and two spells from spell tables. Can mark the weapon as cursed.

Fields.Name: Base Weapon
Fields.Description: EquipParamWeapon row the custom weapon is built from; Upgrade Level is added to this ID, and the rolled skill's Default Weapon Affinity changes the weapon to that affinity.

Fields.Name: Skill Table
Fields.Description: SwordArtsTableParam table the weapon's skill is rolled from. −1: none (the weapon keeps its own skill).

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 1
Fields.Description: AttachEffectTableParam table rolled for the weapon's first effect, in the normal roll (Attach Effect Table 4 replaces it in the cursed roll). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 2
Fields.Description: AttachEffectTableParam table rolled for the weapon's second effect, in the normal roll (Attach Effect Table 5 replaces it in the cursed roll). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 3
Fields.Description: AttachEffectTableParam table rolled for the weapon's third effect, in the normal roll (Attach Effect Table 6 replaces it in the cursed roll). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Upgrade Level
Fields.Description: Added to Base Weapon's ID: the upgrade level of the weapon given. Retail: 0 on most rows; 25, or 1–6 on some.

Fields.Name: Is Unique Weapon
Fields.Description: Marks the given weapon as unique (stored with the weapon, together with the flag the cursed roll sets). What it changes in play is not established. Retail: set on the 476 Unique rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Spell Table 1
Fields.Description: MagicTableParam table rolled for the catalyst's first spell. −1: none (the weapon's own Spell 1 is used).

Fields.Name: Spell Table 2
Fields.Description: MagicTableParam table rolled for the catalyst's second spell; the spell rolled for slot 1 is excluded. −1: none (the weapon's own Spell 2 is used).

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 4 (Cursed)
Fields.Description: Replaces Attach Effect Table 1 in the cursed roll: when the item lot slot's Custom Weapon Effect Tables value is 1, or, when that value is neither 0 nor 1, on the percentage chance ChaosMatchingRankControlParam gives Uncommon and Rare weapons. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 5 (Cursed)
Fields.Description: Replaces Attach Effect Table 2 in the cursed roll (see Attach Effect Table 4). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Table 6 (Cursed)
Fields.Description: Replaces Attach Effect Table 3 in the cursed roll (see Attach Effect Table 4). −1: none.
